title: Hiromu & El Desperado fight for junior supremacy
summary: Hiromu Takahashi and El Desperado turn their contrasting personalities into a recurring struggle for the junior division’s leading position. Their tournament finals become defining tests of pride.

chapters.title: Desperado fights without the mask
chapters.show: Best of the Super Jr. 27 Final
chapters.result: Hiromu defeats Desperado to win the tournament.
chapters.context: After damage to his mask, Desperado removes what remains and fights on, intensifying the personal stakes of their final.

chapters.title: Another final, another Hiromu victory
chapters.show: Best of the Super Jr. 29 Final
chapters.result: Hiromu defeats Desperado in the tournament final.
chapters.context: The repeated showdown reinforces Desperado as a central rival while Hiromu extends his historic tournament success.
